package.name: anubis_command_center
package.description: Minimal web UI proof-of-concept for Anubis: subscribes to the camera image and battery status, and pushes them OUT over an outbound WebSocket connection to a relay running on a VPS (see the sibling anubis_vps_relay, not a ROS package -- it runs on the VPS, not the robot). This shape exists because the robot's cellular/5G link has no public IP to accept inbound connections on -- the robot must be the one that connects out. Answers one question: can an image actually cross that link to a browser, or not. Deliberately simple: no rosbridge_suite/roslibjs yet -- that is the natural next step for real-time, bidirectional, multi-topic access, once this first connectivity check is confirmed working.
